stories.headline: Design moves into discovery as PM roles split and outcome roadmaps take over
stories.dek: Userpilot argues the PM role is dividing in two, with AI-focused PMs commanding far higher pay. Designers are increasingly pulled in at discovery rather than handed finished specs.

stories.headline: Ten product design trends for 2026 and where each one actually works
stories.dek: DesignRush surveys trends from adaptive interfaces to spatial design, arguing winning products have a clear point of view while keeping core flows like checkout clean.

stories.headline: Design systems as competitive infrastructure
stories.dek: El Passion frames the design system as core infrastructure that cuts development cost (vendor claim) and keeps AI-era product teams consistent.

stories.headline: UX research methods as decision tools: choosing by question, stage and team capacity
stories.dek: Lazarev's guide matches each method to the decision it informs, from surveys and interviews to tree testing for IA-heavy dashboards.

stories.headline: UX research tools: AI-assisted analysis and central repositories
stories.dek: UserTesting's roundup covers tools that automate analysis and testing and surface patterns teams may miss, plus repositories for collating findings.

stories.headline: AI launches shift toward the operating layer around agents
stories.dek: A launch radar notes recent activity centres on agent tooling rather than giant new models, such as Copilot Chat search across cloud-agent sessions and AI gateways for cost control.

stories.headline: What's new in AI tools: running changelog
stories.dek: Neuronfeed tracks new releases and updates across AI tools in a running feed.

stories.headline: 2025's AI-fueled scientific breakthroughs, from Alzheimer's diagnosis to weather forecasting
stories.dek: Axios reviews how AI combined with physics-based models improved extreme-weather prediction, and how many advances came from tools built outside traditional research institutions.

stories.headline: Machine intelligence for scientific discovery and engineering invention
stories.dek: Georgetown CSET examines how modern AI and ML are accelerating growth across research disciplines.

stories.headline: Next-generation connected IoT faces a fragmented standards landscape
stories.dek: Panasonic argues sensor and hardware demand across industries is outpacing interoperability, with competing ecosystems and standards.

stories.headline: Dual-channel LoRaWAN energy meter adds CT clamps plus temperature and humidity
stories.dek: CNX Software covers a LoRaWAN AC energy meter with 10A/100A CT clamps and environmental sensing.

stories.headline: AIoT moves intelligence from cloud to edge
stories.dek: DevOps.com explains how pairing sensor data with ML enables real-time analysis at the edge, with 5G pushing compute closer to devices.

stories.headline: Research topic: lightweight AI models and distributed intelligence for AIoT
stories.dek: Frontiers frames open challenges in AIoT: models for constrained devices and splitting intelligence across device, edge and cloud.

stories.headline: When AI meets IoT: will AIoT reshape industries?
stories.dek: Tech Wire Asia looks at AIoT adoption across smart cities, healthcare, manufacturing and logistics, and the security and integration obstacles.

stories.headline: Solar-powered AI greenhouse irrigation cuts 1,277 kWh a year
stories.dek: A study in Energy Engineering reports an IoT and AI irrigation system saving 1,277.5 kWh and 638.75 kg CO2 annually.

stories.headline: Combining renewables, AI and IoT for climate-smart farming
stories.dek: A review in Energies notes agriculture uses nearly 30% of global energy and calls for targeted policy and capacity building.

stories.headline: AI in agricultural energy management
stories.dek: Agritecture claims AI can cut agricultural energy use by up to 15% (industry claim, unverified).

stories.headline: Factorial: Senior Director of Product Design (Barcelona)
stories.dek: Listed at €120,000-150,000 plus equity; requires experience building design teams and owning hiring. Posting dated Feb 2026, so confirm it is still open.

stories.headline: Factorial: Senior/Staff Product Designer
stories.dek: Listed at €68,000-107,000, partnering with the Design Director and product leadership. Posted Jun 2026.

stories.headline: Wallapop: Senior Product Designer
stories.dek: Asks for a very senior profile, ideally 8-10 years in product design with 5+ at senior or lead level.

stories.headline: Spendesk: Senior Product Designer, AI and automation workflows
stories.dek: Hybrid role based in London, Paris, Barcelona or Berlin.

stories.headline: Digital technology is not to blame for our hyperfast lives
stories.dek: An Aeon essay argues digital tech is not the main cause of modern time pressure.

stories.headline: Bernard Stiegler's philosophy on how technology shapes our world
stories.dek: Aeon explores Stiegler's view that tools shape how we understand ourselves, treating technics as an open-ended creative process.
